File No. L. 635
21. 11. 29

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

S. B. Chinese Section.                                November 20th, 1929.

Chung Kwong Tseh (鍾光澤).

Sir,

Reference to the attached inquiries shew that
Chung Kwong Tseh (鍾光澤) was arrested by West Hongkew
Police on Boundary Road on November 9, for distributing
Communistic Literature. He is now serving sentence of one
year imprisonment in the Municipal Gaol, under the name
of Tsoong Wei Zee (鍾維賢). This information has been
duly conveyed to the writer of the attached letter.

A.C. Pol'.

（左侧批注：6A. M.H. 671）
（左侧签名及日期：JR / MG / 20:11 '29. / NOV 21 1929）
（底部批注：S.C. / Information / 21/11 Stay）
（右下签名：Jnd Simmons / C. D. I.）

档案号 L. 635
1929年11月21日

（刑事调查处）办公备忘录

上海公共租界工部局警务处华人探员科。                                1929年11月20日。

鍾光澤。

先生：

经查阅所附查询事项，显示
鍾光澤于11月9日在界路因散发共产主义宣传品被虹口西区巡捕房逮捕。他目前正在市监狱服刑一年，使用的名字为鍾維賢。此信息已正式告知所附信函的撰写人。

代理警务总监。

（左侧批注：6A. M.H. 671）
（左侧签名及日期：JR / MG / 20:11 '29. / 1929年11月21日）
（底部批注：S.C. / 信息 / 11月21日 存查）
（右下签名：Jnd Simmons / 刑事调查处。）

CHARLES B. YANG
ATTORNEY AND COUNSELOR-AT-LAW
E 98 BURKILL ROAD SHANGHAI
TELEPHONE NO. 11661

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D... 33
Date... 8... 11... 29

事務所
白克路九十八號
電話一一六六一

The 7th November, 1929.

Martin, Capt. R. M. J., Deputy Commissioner
Police Force Department, S. M. C., Kiangse Road, Shanghai.

Dear Sir:-

With many thanks, we are very much obliged to apply to Your
Honourable Department.

It is reported by our client, Chung Kwang Tseih(鍾光集),
that he lost his elder brother, Chung Kwang Tseh(鍾光澤), in the
night of the 9th of the past October, who is a native of Canton Pro-
vince and twenty two years in age. He is a student and came to Shan-
ghai for study. He lost his personal trace when he, in the night of
the 9th of October, went to The North Railway Station for seeing the
lantern procession which was taken up for congratulation of The Repu-
blic of China. Since this time, he did not come back home until now,
and our client, Chung Kwang Tseih(鍾光集), is also without any ne-
ws or notice about his lost brother. Our client suspected that his
lost brother might be probably arrested by some police station under
some criminal suspicion and appointed us to apply to Your Honourable
Department with one dozen of photo of his lost brother, Chung Kwang
Tseh (鍾光澤). With many thanks, we humbly request You kindly give
notice to the chief inspector in charge of every police station and
the head gaoler to ask them; Is there any person named, Chung Kwang
Tseh(鍾光澤), to be arrested and put into the gaol since the 9th
of October?" With great thankfulness, we should be very much obliged
if You kindly bless us Your Honourable Favour.

Your obedient servants
Charles B. Yang

CHARLES B. YANG
律师及法律顾问
上海白克路98号
电话 11661

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
收件编号... 33
日期... 1929年11月8日

事務所
白克路九十八號
電話一一六六一

1929年11月7日。

致上海江西路工部局警务处副总监 R. M. J. Martin 上尉。

尊敬的先生：

谨致谢忱，我们非常感激向贵部门提出申请。

据我们的委托人鍾光集(音译)报告，其兄鍾光澤(音译)于上月9日晚失踪。钟氏系广东省人，现年二十二岁。他是一名学生，来沪求学。10月9日晚，他前往北站观看庆祝中华民国的提灯游行队伍时失去踪迹。自那时起至今未归，我们的委托人鍾光集(音译)也未曾收到关于其失踪兄弟的任何消息或通知。我们的委托人怀疑其失踪兄弟可能因涉嫌某种犯罪而被某巡捕房逮捕，并委托我们向贵部门提出申请，随函附上其失踪兄弟鍾光澤(音译)的照片一打。谨致谢忱，恳请阁下惠予通知各巡捕房主管督察长及监狱典狱长，询问他们：“自10月9日以来，是否有名为鍾光澤(音译)的人被逮捕并投入监狱？”如蒙阁下施以恩惠，我们将不胜感激。

您顺从的仆人
Charles B. Yang
